title: New Relic adds terminal-based investigation and recovery checks with Ground Truth CLI
key_facts: New Relic announced Ground Truth CLI, a command-line tool, with its Autopilot API.
It lets developers and AI agents investigate production incidents and check recovery criteria without leaving the terminal.
It connects to Autopilot, NerdGraph and memory APIs.
New Relic's Head of AI Camden Swita said observability is becoming 'headless' and trapped in the 'dashboard era'.
An example: after a change, an engineer checks whether an error-rate check shows recovery and saves findings for handoff.
quote_evidence: New Relic has announced New Relic Ground Truth CLI augmented with New Relic Autopilot API, bringing headless observability straight to developers and AI agents in their natural workflows.
“Traditional observability offerings are trapped in the dashboard era,” said Camden Swita, Head of AI at New Relic.
why_it_matters_hint: Moves incident investigation from dashboards into the terminal where developers and agents work.
notes: Help Net Security relays New Relic's announcement; no independent test.
